tools.name: list_files
tools.title: List workspace files
tools.description: List permitted files/directories inside the workspace. Returns relative paths, type, byte size and modification time. Hidden/protected entries and links are omitted. Use a narrow path and next_offset; recursive scans have a 1000-entry/8-level budget. Read-only.

path.description: Relative directory. Use . for the workspace root.

recursive.description: Include nested directories, up to 8 levels.

offset.description: Skip this many permitted entries. Use next_offset from the previous result.
